body: BUG-1195 round 2 is up: https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/1912. Reconciliation on TASK-1261: the drain log shows both reviewer attempts launched as reviews (envelope role=reviewer) and then died on the interactive lease-held prompt — that is BUG-1205 (#1910, also awaiting your review). Please review+merge #1910 and this one, then rebuild before the next batch. BUG-1197 just retried at phase 1 (no-pr); I am watching it.
